messages:
Maria P.: Quick sync — ACME called, hit a 3x surge last night. They want a one-month soft cap increase + lower overage while they refactor. Asking for 30% discount on overage for the month.
Sam (sales): On our side, ACME is a legacy commit (annual). They exceeded burst allowance — billing flagged it. They’re sensitive to downtime.
Alex (eng): If we increase burst cap for them we need to lock routing to dedicated pool or risk noisy neighbor. That requires a config toggle + short infra change. Estimated ~2 engineer-days.
Jordan (finance): 30% discount on overage wipes margin unless we cap absolute spend. Suggest instead: temporary discounted cap up to $X + normal overage beyond.
Liz (legal): Any price change needs an MSA amendment. We can do a short addendum with an expiry date and explicit surge cap. I can draft a one-pager.
Maria P.: Goal: keep customer online, avoid immediate churn, but not set bad precedent. Need launch criteria for the temporary program.
Sam (sales): Proposed on-call for the customer, SLA of 99.5% for the month, and automatic revert to prior terms on date. Also require a post-mortem and a plan from customer to limit future surges.
Alex (eng): Ops impact: toggle + route policy + telemetry flagging. Will add a guard: if error-rate or latency degrades, auto-fallback to baseline and notify SE.
Maria P.: Draft launch checklist (short):
- legal addendum signed (Liz)
- cap + discounted window defined (Sam & Jordan)
- infra toggle + alerting in place (Alex)
- SE on-call & runbook (Sam)
- post-mortem template and deadline (Maria)

Liz (legal): I can have a draft addendum by EOD tomorrow. Will include explicit expiry and no precedent clause.
Jordan (finance): I’ll compute the recommended $X cap to keep margin >= 20% and share numbers by noon.
Alex (eng): I’ll prototype the toggle and telemetry in a branch, aim to test in staging by tomorrow afternoon.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Staging deploy queued for toggle-feature-ACME (pr #4213) — test window scheduled.
Sam (sales): I’ll tell ACME we can do a conditional pilot: 2-week window first, then extend to month if metrics stable.
Maria P.: Ok. Owners: Liz -> legal addendum, Jordan -> cap number, Alex -> infra toggle + alerts, Sam -> customer comms + SE rota. Meet in 24h to sign off. :thumbsup:
